issue: `retry(fn, attempts)` calls fn one time too many, and when every attempt fails it returns None instead of re-raising the last exception. It should call fn at most `attempts` times, return the first successful result, re-raise the last error if all fail, and raise ValueError if attempts < 1.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

`retry(fn, attempts)` calls fn one time too many, and when every attempt fails it returns None instead of re-raising the last exception. It should call fn at most `attempts` times, return the first successful result, re-raise the last error if all fail, and raise ValueError if attempts < 1.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
